chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Indeed, the Magians trimmed their beards and let their mustaches grow long, whereas we trim the mustaches and leave the beards, and this is the fitrah."

key_terms.نُعْفِي: we leave to grow or spare
key_terms.ٱلْفِطْرَةُ: the natural disposition or innate normative nature
key_terms.ٱلْمَجُوسَ: the Magians, mentioned here as a contrasting community

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about trimming the mustache and leaving the beard?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a teaching of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله concerning grooming practices. It contrasts the practice of the Magians with the sunnah of trimming the mustache and leaving the beard, presenting this as part of the fitrah, the natural disposition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.331 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"The Magians (Zoroastrians) trim their beards and let their mustaches grow long, but we trim the mustaches and let the beards grow, and this is the natural disposition (fitrah)."
